title: Replace the initial page background crackers effect with a different animation

requirements.text: Ensure the initial (first) page no longer displays any “background crackers”/wallpaper-style background layer, including removing/avoiding any usage of the generated asset `/assets/generated/valentine-bg.dim_1920x1080.png` and any related fixed background-image layer so the prompt card sits on the gradient background only.

quotes: remove that background crackers one and add some another animation

acceptanceCriteria: On the initial page, there is no crackers/wallpaper background visible behind the prompt card.
The frontend codebase contains no active reference that renders `/assets/generated/valentine-bg.dim_1920x1080.png` on the initial page.

requirements.text: Replace the current initial-page background animation (the floating heart emoticons rendered by `InitialFloatingHearts`) with a different background animation that runs continuously behind the prompt card, does not block pointer events, and does not interfere with the evasive button interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: `InitialFloatingHearts` is no longer rendered on the initial page, and the heart-emoticon background animation is not visible.
A new background animation is visible on the initial page behind the prompt card and runs continuously.
The background animation layer uses `pointer-events: none` (or equivalent) so all buttons remain fully interactive on desktop and mobile.
The new animation stays confined to the initial page (non-celebration state) and does not alter the celebration overlay behavior.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, and anything under `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep the Internet Computer backend as a single Motoko actor; no additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not change any user-facing text content/copy.
Do not change the celebration overlay animations/effects.
No backend (Motoko) changes are required for this request.
